name: Alistair MacLeod
bio: Alistair MacLeod's journey into motorsport began with a childhood obsession with aerodynamics. Growing up in the Highlands, he spent hours observing the way wind shaped the landscape, translating those observations into model aircraft designs. He pursued a degree in aerospace engineering before transitioning into motorsport, working his way up through various teams, always focusing on optimizing aerodynamic performance. Alistair believes in a holistic approach to aero development, emphasizing the interplay between computational fluid dynamics, wind tunnel testing, and on-track data analysis. He is known for his ability to identify subtle yet impactful improvements, pushing the boundaries of what's aerodynamically possible.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Alistair is a man of medium build with a thoughtful expression and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with sketches and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
Insists on a specific brand of Scottish shortbread during late-night design sessions.
